name: ethercat-single-slave-reconfigure
title: EtherCAT single-slave reconfiguration
description: Add an explicit bounded single-slave EtherCAT reconfiguration operation that validates retained topology/product evidence, revokes only affected readiness, reuses existing SM/FMMU/PDO/DC configuration authorities, preserves unrelated slaves and cyclic traffic, stops at PREOP, and exposes typed progress/results.
